summary: The diff implements %TypedArray%.prototype.filter steps 1-12 in spec order, with each step kept as a comment above its code. ValidateTypedArray and TypedArrayLength run before the IsCallable check, and the callback is called through ops::call with `?`. ToBoolean, TypedArrayGetElement (no `?`, as in the spec), TypedArraySpeciesCreate and TypedArraySetElement are used as the spec specifies. There are no test-shaped branches, no hardcoded results and no swallowed errors. The one lint flag (unreachable! after validate_typed_array) is justified, since RequireInternalSlot in step 1 of ValidateTypedArray guarantees an object on success. The `?` on the `Perform !` call in step 11 is harmless because the element is already a Number or BigInt, so no conversion can throw. The remaining 132 failures are the not-implemented Math.floor used by the test harness, not defects in this change.
notes_for_next_attempt: Nothing blocking. Optional: confirm that validate_typed_array takes a Value and enforces an object via RequireInternalSlot, which is what makes the unreachable! in prototype_filter.rs truly unreachable. The spec's prose note "This method is not generic..." was dropped from the comments; it is not a step, so this is cosmetic.
